# Data Storage Lab

Canonical URL: https://datastoragelab.com/

Data Storage Lab provides vendor-neutral planning tools for home and small-team data storage. Tools distinguish decimal-TB primary capacity, protection, independent backups, growth, and expansion headroom. They do not recommend specific products or treat RAID as a backup.

Current public areas:
- Home: https://datastoragelab.com/
- Tools: https://datastoragelab.com/tools/
- Storage needs hub: https://datastoragelab.com/tools/storage-needs/
- Home Storage & Backup Planner: https://datastoragelab.com/tools/storage-needs/home-storage-backup-planner/
- Annual Storage Growth Calculator: https://datastoragelab.com/tools/storage-needs/annual-storage-growth-calculator/
- Creator Media Storage Planner: https://datastoragelab.com/tools/storage-needs/creator-media-storage-planner/
- Computer Backup Storage Planner: https://datastoragelab.com/tools/storage-needs/computer-backup-storage-planner/
- Small Office Storage Planner: https://datastoragelab.com/tools/storage-needs/small-office-storage-planner/
- Media Library Storage Planner: https://datastoragelab.com/tools/storage-needs/media-library-storage-planner/
- Guide: https://datastoragelab.com/guides/how-much-nas-storage-do-i-need/
- Reference: https://datastoragelab.com/reference/tb-vs-tib/
